old: Der Klown fennel and apple salad

dish.n: Der Klown pork schnitzel with fennel slaw
dish.note: Crumbed pork schnitzel with apple and fennel slaw, eaten before the jack in the box opens.
dish.how: Pound the pork steaks thin. Dip them in flour, beaten egg, then breadcrumbs. Shallow-fry in hot oil for 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked through, then drain. Shave the fennel and apples thin and toss with the lemon juice, mustard and olive oil. Serve the schnitzels with the slaw and lemon wedges.
dish.make_ahead: Crumb the schnitzels up to 4 hours ahead and chill; fry and dress the slaw to serve

steps.text: Pound the pork thin, then dip in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry for 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked through, then drain.
Shave the fennel and apples thin and toss with lemon juice, mustard and olive oil.
Serve the schnitzels with the slaw and lemon wedges.

veg.n: Der Klown eggplant schnitzel with fennel slaw
veg.make_ahead: Crumb the eggplant up to 4 hours ahead and chill; fry and dress the slaw to serve

steps.text: Slice the eggplants 1cm thick, salt for 10 minutes and pat dry, then dip in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry for 3 minutes a side until golden and soft inside, then drain.
Shave the fennel and apples thin and toss with lemon juice, mustard and olive oil.
Serve the schnitzels with the slaw and lemon wedges.

dish.vegNote: Crumbed eggplant schnitzel with apple and fennel slaw, eaten before the jack in the box opens.
